context:
Goal: MANIFEST on the open Duo breaks the phone-list mold.
Problem: a blind designer drew five concepts from the mail-day job, not from today's screens. Only you pick the direction.
Pictures: a) to e) each have a drawing above. f) has none of its own: it is a) with c)'s past-transit page and b)'s Suspense line.
Meanwhile: nothing is built; the restyle continues.
Also open: the claim window (assumed 28 days) and usual transit time (assumed 10 days). Put them in the note if you know them.
home: a new mailaudit decision record on the Duo layout

options.gain: Fastest match with cards in hand; works one-handed.
options.how: Type a few letters of the card you hold; the app shows its envelope and what else should be in it.
options.label: Card in Hand

options.gain: Money and owed cards read like a ledger, fits the parchment look.
options.how: Each seller is an account that owes you cards; blank envelopes sit in a Suspense line until matched.
options.label: Account Book
options.lose: Less direct for the open-the-envelope moment.

options.gain: Lost mail is obvious at a glance.
options.how: Envelopes sit in pigeonholes by thickness and age; the fold splits in-transit from past-usual-transit.
options.label: Sorting Frame
options.lose: Thickness is a guess the app has to make.

options.how: The app writes today's mail as a short letter; you answer by touching its words.
options.label: The Letter

options.gain: Uses the hardware like nothing else.
options.how: Closing the phone seals what came; the hinge angle picks a blank envelope's sender.
options.label: Fold to Seal (wild)
options.lose: Impractical; easy to trigger by accident.

options.gain: Fast matching, lost mail and blank envelopes each get their best tool.
options.how: Card in Hand, plus Sorting Frame's past-transit page and Account Book's Suspense line.
options.label: Card in Hand + two borrowed parts
options.lose: More to build than one pure concept.

ref: PR #139 (blind Duo concepts, draft); served at localhost:4190
title: Which Duo concept should MANIFEST grow from?
why: The designer's pick: each part answers one mail-day job best.
